_owner: Younes (Youcef reads only). Simulation, experiment and smart-controller settings, so no number is typed in the code.

demand.sources: RAMP-style stochastic demand (Lombardi et al., Energy 177 (2019) 433-444): each day every appliance's usage window shifts by up to time_jitter_h, non-critical appliances are used with probability noncritical_use_prob, and usage intensity varies with coefficient of variation intensity_cv. Parameters are assumptions to be replaced by survey or meter data.

outdoor_shaded_box.why: metal box outside in the shade: follows air temperature, enclosure adds heat

indoor_metal_roof.why: room under a corrugated metal roof: some damping, roof heat gain

indoor_masonry.why: thick mud-brick or block room: daily swing damped, same mean

cool_interior_floor.why: on the floor of the coolest interior room, ground-coupled

placement_study.sources: Lumped two-node thermal model. Pack: the selected kit's 25.6 V, 75 Ah LFP module (1.92 kWh), ~18 kg, cp ~1100 J/(kg K), ~15 mOhm (8 prismatic cells + busbars and BMS; first placement study used the 51.2 V, 100 Ah, ~45 kg, ~25 mOhm placeholder pack). Placement time constants and offsets are scenario assumptions (engineering judgement), to be measured with a temperature logger in pilot homes.

uncertain_inputs.why: cell-to-cell and manufacturer spread in calendar ageing rate
how strongly a full battery ages faster (the effect SABIL exploits)
battery temperature above outdoor air (indoor siting, enclosure)

oracle.sources: Benchmark only. Costs in kWh-equivalents of non-critical energy (valued at diesel generation, ~USD 1/kWh: NGN 3,277/L x 0.5 L/kWh at ~NGN 1,550/USD). Critical energy weighted 50x. lambda_degradation = value of the whole capacity fraction: replacing the selected 1.92 kWh LFP module at ~USD 150/kWh (~USD 290) when 20% is lost -> ~USD 1,440 per unit fraction -> ~1,400 kWh-equivalents (3,700 for the 5.12 kWh placeholder pack used first). TO CONFIRM against Youcef's costs.json.

sources: Site from the team contract. Weather: NASA POWER hourly 2014-2023 (multi_year mode uses each real year once; repeat mode repeats repeat_year as in the original contract). CO2: IPCC 2006 Guidelines default for diesel/gas oil, 74,100 kg CO2/TJ x 43.0 TJ/Gg x 0.84 kg/L = 2.68 kg CO2/L. Smart-controller thresholds are design choices, justified by the soc_cap_hot sweep (results/experiments). Uncertainty ranges are engineering judgement, stated per input. cloudy_day_buffer (Youcef, sizing review 31 Oct): share of tomorrow's critical energy kept in the capped charge, so a wrong 'sunny tomorrow' forecast does not cut critical loads; 0.5 removed lost critical hours in the 64-case reliability map.
